BezEQ4.what: A four-band BezEQ with frequency controls.
BezEQ4.sound: Not documented upstream yet. Written from the control names only.
BezEQ4.use: Four-band shelving EQ with sweepable frequencies.

FastDistance.sound: Rolls off highs like distant sound, cheap enough for many sources and wild modulation.
FastDistance.use: Game audio and any source that should sound far away.

controls.Distnce: How far away: more distance, less treble.

BezEQ3.what: Four vivid, unified Bezier-crossover bands, with zero latency.
BezEQ3.sound: A phasier, more vivid EQ than a normal one.

Suzan.what: A new type of ladder filter.
Suzan.sound: A state-variable-style resonant filter with a sin() twist.

SmoothEQ3.what: The most approachable EQ: the EQ section of ConsoleH.
SmoothEQ3.use: A basic tone EQ that always sounds good.

PearEQ.sound: Based on the Pear filter from the Holt filter, as in ConsoleMC and ConsoleLA.
PearEQ.use: Colourful graphic EQ with six fixed bands.

PearLiteEQ.sound: A secret weapon in the console emulations, now standalone.

RetroBass.sound: Grew from a 2nd and 4th harmonic generator; reshapes bass.

FatEQ.sound: Uses Density's functions so boosted loud sounds saturate rather than just getting louder.

SmoothEQ2.what: A wildly intuitive four-band vibe EQ with clarity and intensity.
SmoothEQ2.sound: Four shelving bands with frequency sweeps for clear subtle moves.

BezEQ2.what: A unique, subtle three-band shelving EQ.
BezEQ2.sound: Crossed bands that sum back with perfect fidelity.

BezEQ.what: A strange, alien three-band shelving EQ.
BezEQ.sound: Bezier-curve crossovers give a sound like no other EQ.

SmoothEQ.what: A sharp, accurate, transparent three-band filter.
SmoothEQ.sound: Accurate and well behaved, a by-ear EQ like analog ones.

Parametric.what: Three ConsoleX EQ bands as a standalone plugin.

Dattorro.what: The resonant lowpass filter out of Donut: a state-variable filter.
Dattorro.sound: A simple, efficient SVF that can stand in for a biquad.

Donut.what: An envelope-following filter in memory of Dilla.
Donut.sound: An envelope follower driving filter frequency and resonance.
Donut.use: Dilla-style filtered grooves and other effects.

controls.MoveFrq: How far the envelope moves the frequency.
controls.MoveRes: How far the envelope moves the resonance.

Silken.what: A high-frequency boost that gives ambience and texture.
Silken.sound: Subtracts a brickwall-ish lowpass for silky highs.
Silken.use: Adding airy ambience and texture to the top end.

Stonefire.what: The non-EQ EQ designed for ConsoleX.
Stonefire.sound: Kalman filters for a unique tone-split: Stone for lows and Fire for highs.
Stonefire.use: Tone shaping that behaves unlike normal EQs.

AngleEQ.sound: Irregular and non-flat; never meant as your main EQ.

AngleFilter.sound: Very strange and weird, an offshoot of the AngleEQ filter.

Isolator3.what: Isolator2 on one slider, with a band-narrower control.
Isolator3.sound: Centre is full range, left is lowpass, right is highpass.
Isolator3.use: DJ-style filter sweeps on one knob.

controls.Iso: The sweep: lowpass to the left, highpass to the right.

Baxandall3.what: A Baxandall with new tone colours.
Baxandall3.sound: Tone colours not heard before, from combining Baxandall and Baxandall2.
Baxandall3.use: Broad treble and bass shaping with unusual flavours.

Baxandall2.sound: Broad strokes bass and treble, with interleaved biquads.

Baxandall.sound: Bit-identical at zero; broad gentle boosts with a mid notch when both are boosted.
Baxandall.use: Simple bass and treble tone control.

Pear2.sound: Fixed, bit-shifted cutoffs plus a nonlinear option.
Pear2.use: Shelving high or low filters with character.

Capacitor2.sound: Models how ceramic capacitors lose capacitance under voltage.
Capacitor2.use: Lowpass and highpass with analog-style nonlinearity.

Distance3.what: Combines the best parts of Distance and Discontinuity.
Distance3.sound: Darkens the sound and makes it far away, with air nonlinearity.
Distance3.use: Sound design, moving sounds back, or loudness.

controls.Top dB: Top level, setting the apparent peak loudness.

Pear.what: A highpass/lowpass shelf testbed with a new filter type.
Pear.sound: A fixed-frequency shelving filter with bit-shifted cutoffs.
Pear.use: Experimental filtering in the Console family.

ResEQ2.what: A single, sharp, sonorous mid peak.
ResEQ2.sound: Clarity and character beyond a biquad, from the MCI console work.

SubTight.what: Tightens sub-lows using a variation on Creature.
SubTight.sound: A soft slew clipper that cancels sub-lows.

CStrip2.what: A refined CStrip with Capacitor filters and saturation.
CStrip2.sound: Three-band EQ, Capacitor highpass/lowpass, the original compressor, and a saturation stage.

Weight.what: A very accurate sub-bass boost based on Holt.
Weight.use: Adding deep sub-bass to live drums, DI bass or guitar.

Isolator2.what: Isolator with control smoothing and a resonance booster.
Isolator2.sound: A very steep lowpass, highpass or shelf, now steeper, with added resonance.
Isolator2.use: DJ-style sweeps and synth filter tones.

Kalman.what: A filter based on GPS Kalman filtering. Not a real filter.
Kalman.sound: A noisy-data estimator that darkens in a gritty, unusual way.
Kalman.use: Strange filtering and the foundation of Stonefire.

PrimeFIR.what: A mostly linear-phase brickwall with a taste for the bizarre.
PrimeFIR.sound: A tiny window and prime-number taps, inspired by Six Sines.

Holt2.sound: Like Aura for bass: a fuzzy, vivid resonance.

Holt.what: A synth-like resonant lowpass focussed on bass.
Holt.sound: A trend-following filter with a fuzzy character.

ToneSlant.what: A super-transparent tilt EQ with very low Q.
ToneSlant.sound: A tilt around an adjustable corner point.

controls.Highs: Tilt towards or away from highs.

AverMatrix.what: Averaging turned into a full-featured EQ.
AverMatrix.sound: Clean averaging with tunable comb artefacts.

Average.what: A distinctive lowpass based on simple averaging.
Average.sound: Averages adjacent samples. Very clean in time; comb artefacts at higher settings.

MackEQ.what: The Mackie distortion with treble and bass added.
MackEQ.sound: Mangling sounds like a cranked Mackie 1202 with EQ.

Hull2.sound: Pristine and simple, with no saturation. From ConsoleLA's high band.

Hull.what: An alternate highpass/lowpass based on a stock-market indicator.
Hull.sound: Dark lowpass at one end of Bright, highpass at the other.

controls.Bright: Lowpass at left, highpass at right.

EQ.what: Just the EQ parts of CStrip.
EQ.sound: A lossless three-band with special highpass and lowpass; bit-identical when flat.

Capacitor.what: A lowpass/highpass filter of a new type.
Capacitor.sound: Not a biquad, with a characteristic quirk at one third of the sample rate.

Isolator.what: A steep highpass or lowpass like a speaker crossover.
Isolator.sound: Steep DJ-style filtering for sweeping down to a throb or up to highs.

TapeFat.sound: An averaging filter on prime-number delay taps, like a dense ambience control.
TapeFat.use: Rolling off highs or removing lows.

ResEQ.what: A bank of mostly midrange resonances.
ResEQ.sound: The opposite of a Soothe-style plugin: adds resonances.

Lowpass2.sound: Four poles of interleaved IIR with soft/hard tone doctoring; fully open at any sample rate.

Highpass2.sound: Four poles with loose/tight tone doctoring; good for subsonic roll-off.

Distance.what: A far-away-izer for sound design or reverb.
Distance.use: Moving sounds back in the mix.

Distance2.what: A versatile space shaper, a hybrid of Distance and Atmosphere.
Distance2.sound: Makes drums huge, pounding and stage-like without reverb or compression.

Lowpass.what: A lowpass that deepens the tone, leaving gloss.
Lowpass.sound: Interleaved IIR for a deeper tone and textural change.

Highpass.what: A highpass time warp for retro midrangey sounds.
Highpass.sound: The complement of Lowpass, with different behaviour.
